I would like to write the truth here. The photos are very nice but the hotel itself isn't. The restaurant is not a restaurant it's just tables, and you can have toast. Bathrooms were dirty. Rooms were dirty. Mold everywhere. The food was awful. The only Plus was that we got Rooms very fast at 6 am upon landing.

A mouse ran through the lobby. We saw the staff sleeping the lobby as well on sofas and floor.
